pages.text: Used to brew the rich Sweat Drink.$(br2)Needs the boots to reach level 3 (the level is baked into the sweaty boots — taking them off and re-wearing keeps it); hold them in your main hand + an empty bottle in your offhand, sneak + right-click to pour.$(br2)Armor: 1 (same as leather), shown on the tooltip.$(br2)Crafted from leather boots + sugar.
